objectives.label: Dig out {victims} — a pickaxe or shovel in hand

title: Collapse in the mine!
Trapped below
summary: The mine at {settlement} has fallen in, and {victims} are trapped. Props first, then dig.
offer: The gallery came down an hour ago and {victims} are behind it. We need timber for props before anyone goes in — bring logs, then dig with us. Hurry!
progress: Can you hear them? Keep digging!
complete: They are out — bruised, coughing, alive. You have friends for life in this town.
